name: fix-color-cast
summary: Neutralise a color cast by setting a gray point on something that should be neutral.
when: The image has a tint (warm tungsten, green fluorescent, blue shade) and contains a neutral reference: gray card, white wall, concrete, paper.
photoshop: Layer > New Adjustment Layer > Curves, then the Set Gray Point eyedropper on the neutral area
notes: Pick a mid-tone neutral, not a highlight. If no neutral exists, balance by eye with the per-channel curves instead.
